method: Targeted primary-research and official-tool review, not an exhaustive systematic review.

sources.title: Patient preferences for implantable BCIs in motor neuron disease
sources.finding: A survey with 39 respondents emphasized useful functions, ease, accuracy, reliability, and support.
sources.limitations: 32 completed the survey. Stated preferences do not demonstrate adoption or benefit from this repo.
sources.design_inference: Prioritize useful access and sustained support; measure setup, training, and support burden.

sources.title: Patient perspectives after high cervical spinal cord injury
sources.finding: A four-person focus group described desired digital independence and practical usability concerns.
sources.limitations: Small qualitative cohort; preferences are not population-wide estimates.
sources.design_inference: Use communication and computer access as a co-design candidate; preserve individual preferences.

sources.title: BCI priorities of potential users with spinal cord injury
sources.finding: A 40-person survey identified useful functions, emergency communication, and simple setup as priorities.
sources.limitations: Older convenience sample; desired performance is not a universal release threshold.
sources.design_inference: Measure idle errors, setup and access to a help request; never make the prototype a sole emergency channel.

sources.title: Long-term independent intracortical speech and cursor BCI use
sources.finding: One participant used a multimodal implanted system at home for over 3,800 hours with interface and decoder support.
sources.limitations: Intracortical single-participant evidence; it does not establish scalp-EEG performance or this repo's capability.
sources.design_inference: Treat interface, calibration, corrections, privacy and support as part of the system; distinguish task accuracy from natural use.

sources.title: Personalized adaptable speech and cursor BCI interface, CHI 2026
sources.finding: A 22-month co-design deployment with one participant was adapted to a second participant.
sources.limitations: Small deployment; may overlap the home-use cohort in S04. Do not count these as independent large cohorts.
sources.design_inference: Make interface preferences versioned, exportable and revisable through accessible controls.

sources.title: EDAPT continual online adaptation
sources.finding: Population pretraining and supervised trial-wise updates improved evaluated decoding across several datasets.
sources.limitations: Uses revealed labels; offline/open-loop evidence does not establish autonomous closed-loop benefit.
sources.design_inference: Evaluate supervised personalization with chronological labels and guarded artifact promotion.

sources.title: NoMAD latent-dynamics alignment for BCI stability
sources.finding: Temporal latent alignment improved stability in the studied intracortical decoding settings.
sources.limitations: Representation assumptions and recording modality matter; unsupervised alignment cannot prove semantic label correctness.
sources.design_inference: Include alignment as a separately qualified research adapter and monitor loss of correspondence.

sources.title: Co-adaptive user and decoder interactions
sources.finding: Control/game-theoretic analysis was evaluated with 14 people using an adaptive myoelectric interface.
sources.limitations: EMG study; learning-rate results cannot be assumed to transfer to EEG or impaired populations.
sources.design_inference: Separate control and adaptation timescales and test interacting learner dynamics.

sources.title: Cross-session conformal command gating
sources.finding: Selective gates reduced erroneous decisions at the cost of decisiveness in cross-session motor imagery experiments.
sources.limitations: Session shift challenges exchangeability; empirical coverage is not an unconditional safety guarantee.
sources.design_inference: Compare gates at matched coverage and risk, with independent calibration and shift monitoring.

sources.title: EEG-FM-Compass foundation model benchmark
sources.finding: A comparative benchmark found specialists competitive and model scale alone insufficient for universal transfer.
sources.limitations: Conclusions depend on protocols, tasks, and training regimes; no blanket verdict on every model.
sources.design_inference: Require compact baselines and resource-aware comparisons before promoting a foundation encoder.

sources.title: Preprocessing-dependent EEG prediction instability
sources.finding: The authors investigated how plausible preprocessing changes can alter predictions despite fixed model confidence.
sources.limitations: Preprint and studied intervention space; does not validate a universal preprocessing-uncertainty estimator.
sources.design_inference: Bind preprocessing identity and run a bounded sensitivity audit before qualification.

sources.title: Backpropagation-free transformations for EEG adaptation
sources.finding: Source-trained ranking of transformed trial predictions supports forward-pass-only adaptation experiments.
sources.limitations: The evaluated tasks and computational results do not establish platform-wide latency or clinical transfer.
sources.design_inference: Test low-compute transformed ensembles as optional alternatives, with bounded inference budgets.

sources.title: EEG BCI control with AI copilots
sources.finding: Shared assistance was demonstrated for cursor and robotic tasks using noninvasive EEG.
sources.limitations: Published system-specific results are not results or novelty evidence for SynapDrive.
sources.design_inference: Benchmark bounded assistance against direct control and fixed assistance.

sources.title: Levels of shared autonomy in multimodal brain-robot interaction
sources.finding: A configuration-specific study compared assistance levels and reported workload, usability, reliability and agency tradeoffs.
sources.limitations: Multimodal lab configuration; patient-level generalization is not established by this design review.
sources.design_inference: Permit user-selected automation scope; do not equate agency with compulsory low automation.

sources.title: Inner speech and privacy in motor-cortex neuroprostheses
sources.finding: Four implanted participants supported limited inner-speech decoding experiments and strategies against unintended output.
sources.limitations: Not unrestricted mind reading and not scalp EEG evidence; privacy defenses are initial explorations.
sources.design_inference: Require explicit engagement and privacy lock independent of model confidence; do not implement private-thought inference.

sources.title: Measuring language-prior influence in ALS BCI communication
sources.finding: Retrospective P300 re-decoding separates neural evidence and language-prior contributions to output.
sources.limitations: A computational attribution measure cannot establish a person's true meaning or authorship; preprint status.
sources.design_inference: Preserve neural, assisted and approved output separately and evaluate prior-only controls when logits are available.

sources.title: EEG data-alignment adversarial defense benchmark
sources.finding: Comparative experiments examine neural-decoder sensitivity to adversarial input and defense choices.
sources.limitations: Perturbation robustness in a benchmark does not establish secure acquisition, realistic attacker access, or universal defense.
sources.design_inference: Separate bounded numerical robustness tests from transport and process-security threat models.

sources.title: NASA runtime-assurance verification framework
sources.finding: A formal framework relates advanced control, trusted fallback, plant dynamics and monitoring assumptions.
sources.limitations: The framework is not a certification of this software or a proof for an unspecified plant.
sources.design_inference: State recoverability and timing assumptions explicitly and validate one bounded plant model first.

sources.title: MOABB evaluation and dataset API
sources.finding: Provides established dataset, paradigm and within/cross-session/subject evaluation abstractions.
sources.limitations: Use a pinned version and declared target-data access; benchmark use alone does not prevent every leakage.
sources.design_inference: Add grouped protocols, immutable split manifests and explicit target calibration permissions.

sources.title: BIDS EEG metadata specification
sources.finding: Defines EEG metadata for acquisition, channels, electrodes, coordinates and related recording context.
sources.limitations: Metadata conformance does not prove correct labeling, valid consent, or scientific comparability.
sources.design_inference: Preserve acquisition/coordinate/units metadata rather than reducing identity to channel count.

sources.title: LSL time synchronization documentation
sources.finding: Explains source timestamps, clock offsets, synchronization options and online/offline timing treatment.
sources.limitations: LSL clocks are not interchangeable with wall clocks; bounds still need measurement.
sources.design_inference: Retain timestamps, gaps and clock domains; refuse time-critical operation when age cannot be bounded.

sources.title: MNE EDF loader documentation
sources.finding: Provides a maintained recording reader with explicit channel and format handling options.
sources.limitations: Library use does not guarantee correct event interpretation or preprocessing.
sources.design_inference: Use tested optional scientific I/O rather than broadening the custom loader by assumption.

sources.title: PhysioNet motor movement and imagery dataset
sources.finding: Provides annotated rest and movement/imagery recordings with run-dependent event semantics.
sources.limitations: Cued/rest recordings do not represent every natural no-command state; execution and imagery labels differ.
sources.design_inference: Build explicit rest/imagery protocols without converting annotations into unrestricted real-world intent claims.

sources.title: pyRiemann minimum-distance-to-mean classifier API
sources.finding: Defines an established covariance-classification baseline for compatible experiments.
sources.limitations: A development documentation URL is not a dependency pin; select a released version for implementation.
sources.design_inference: Use a specialist baseline and retain exact library/model/preprocessing versions.

sources.title: Shared autonomy via hindsight optimization
sources.finding: Models uncertainty over goals and assistance choices, with user-control tradeoffs.
sources.limitations: POMDP assistance and uncertainty-aware goal selection are existing prior art.
sources.design_inference: Evaluate hypothesis-compatible progress as an extension of the cited methods; no new foundational algorithm is claimed.

sources.title: ICLR 2026 comparison of EEG foundation and traditional models
sources.finding: A multi-protocol comparison found foundation-model advantages dependent on data and evaluation regime.
sources.limitations: No model family is a guaranteed winner; exact supported artifacts require separate checks.
sources.design_inference: Promote by demonstrated risk/coverage/resource benefit rather than architecture size.

sources.title: Periodic and aperiodic features for asynchronous BCI
sources.finding: In-press experiments distinguish control from non-control using periodic/aperiodic evidence in a supported SSVER setting.
sources.limitations: Paradigm-specific EEG/OPM-MEG and online task results do not establish a universal idle detector. Online listings give different September dates; year precision is retained.
sources.design_inference: Evaluate complementary state evidence only in a separately supported asynchronous paradigm, with false-activation exposure and latency.
